A TASTE OF SONG
宋 代 四 般 闲 事

One long table, one afternoon,
and everyone’s hands busy.

Zhuanta Hutong · 26 September 2026

砖塔胡同 · 2026 年 9 月 26 日 · 八月十六

On the Saturday after Mid-Autumn, we set one long table in a hutong courtyard. People came from different countries and different working lives, sat down, put on gloves, and spent the afternoon making things with their hands.

中秋后的那个周六，胡同院子里摆了一张长桌。来自不同国家、不同行业的人坐下来，戴上手套，用一个下午做点手上的事。

This is what it looked like.

这是那个下午的样子。

宋 · 赵佶（传）《文会图》局部 · the Song table, as it was set
I
THE COURTYARD
合 院
合 院 · the gate on Zhuanta Hutong

Heyuan Space sits on Zhuanta Hutong in Xicheng. Lu Xun lived on this lane in 1923, and the walls inside still carry his photographs.

合院 space 在西城区砖塔胡同。1923 年鲁迅曾住在这条胡同里，院里的墙上还挂着他的老照片。

Old photographs, a red door

At the door, everyone signed the guestbook — in as many scripts as there were guests.

进门先签到。签名簿上，有几位客人，就有几种笔迹。

签 到 簿 与 请 柬 · the guestbook
II
THE SWEETS
练 切 · 宋 代 茶 点
张 冬 华 老 师 · what is nerikiri?

Zhang Donghua began with a question on the screen: what is nerikiri? A dough built on white bean paste — soft enough to take any shape, firm enough to keep it.

张冬华老师从一个问题讲起：什么是练切？以豆沙为底，软到可以捏成任何形状，又稳到能把形状留住。

Then the gloves went on.

然后，大家戴上了手套。

Most of the table chose chrysanthemums — it was, after all, the season. No two came out the same.

大多数人捏了菊花——毕竟正是时令。没有两朵是一样的。

当 场 做 好 · made at the table, taken home
III
A FLORAL MOMENT
花 道 展 示 · 林 派 花 道

At the head of the table, Danielle Han (Han Danning) and Li Bingfei — both first-dan inheritors of the Lin school of Chinese floral art — set their arrangements one stem at a time, while the room went quiet to watch.

桌首，林派花道一段传承人韩丹宁、李冰菲现场插花，一枝一枝立起来。屋里安静下来，大家看着花慢慢成形。

备 花 · stems sorted before the arrangement
IV
A GUQIN INTERLUDE
古 琴 一 曲
Lu Yixing
陆 一 行
QIJIAN heritage apprentice · Guqin, Guangling School
齐间非遗学徒 · 广陵琴派 · 古琴

Between the flowers and the talking, Yixing played one piece in the courtyard. The guqin has been on UNESCO’s list of intangible cultural heritage since 2003; for a few minutes, nobody reached for their phone.

花事与交谈之间，一行在院子里抚琴一曲。古琴艺术 2003 年列入联合国教科文组织人类非遗名录。那几分钟，没有人去看手机。

V
YOUR HOSTS
当 日 主 持

Danielle (Han Danning) and Adrii (Huang Wanhong) kept the afternoon moving in both languages, and introduced the table to itself.

主持人韩丹宁 Danielle 与黄婉虹 Adrii，中英双语串起整个下午，也把席上的人介绍给彼此。

VI
WHO SAT AT THIS TABLE
这 一 桌 的 人

Many first-timers, many languages, one table. Some had never held a wagashi needle before; everyone went home with something they made.

很多人第一次来，很多种语言，一张桌子。有人第一次拿起捏针，每个人都带走了自己做的东西。

26 . 09 . 2026  ·  合 院

Thank you to everyone who sat down with us.

谢谢每一位坐下来的人。

Some of Chinese culture you can see through glass. The rest you come to know slowly, sitting down beside someone who actually does it.

有些中国文化，隔着展柜可以看见；有些，要坐下来，跟着真正做这件事的人，才能慢慢知道。

United by Art · Fulfilled through People
